title: Health Advisory on Air Pollution - Annexure IV: School Children
issuer: NCDC / DGHS / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
jurisdiction: India national public-health advisory, including Greater Noida; not a school-closure order
reference: Cover D.O. dated 01.11.2025; PDF page 26, printed page 22, Annexure IV paragraph 5(ii)
excerpt: Schools to limit outdoor activities during days of higher pollution levels
limitation: Advisory, not verified active legal order; qualitative wording supplies no model-concentration trigger. Cover date belongs to accompanying Ministry letter.

title: Health Advisory on Air Pollution under NPCCHH, September 2022
issuer: NCDC / DGHS / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
jurisdiction: India national public-health advisory; general public and vulnerable populations, not a local order
reference: PDF page 15, printed page 14, Annexure I / I. General Population / item 9; cover states September 2022
excerpt: Reschedule outdoor activities as per AQI, and remain indoors on days with poor to severe AQI.
limitation: Historical advisory context, not proof of current GRAP activation; no AQI is inferred from instantaneous model concentrations.

title: AirWise synthetic-school evidence review policy
excerpt: Regional forecasts prompt administrator review only; they do not activate legal orders, closures, or timetable restrictions automatically.
limitation: No numerical pollution thresholds or legal powers; authenticated review is always required.
